Loops

for iterates. The word after it is the mode — what kind of traversal this is — and it is required, so a loop always says what it walks.

ModeWalks
fromthe values of a collection
refthe keys of a table, or the indices of a list
rangea numeric range

Over values#

freader locale
faber convert --to en — English reader surface
main {
    let list<int> numeri ← [1, 2, 3]
    for from numeri let n {
        print n
    }
}
faber convert --to la — canonical Faber
incipit {
    sit lista<numerus> numeri ← [1, 2, 3]
    itera ex numeri sit n {
        nota n
    }
}
faber convert --to th-TH — Thai
เริ่ม {
    กำหนด รายการ<จํานวน> numeri ← [1, 2, 3]
    วน ออก numeri กำหนด n {
        บันทึก n
    }
}
faber convert --to zh-Hans — Simplified Chinese
入口 {
    设 列表<整数> numeri ← [1, 2, 3]
    遍历 取自 numeri 设 n {
        显示 n
    }
}
faber convert --to zh-Hant — Traditional Chinese
入口 {
    設為 列表<整數> numeri ← [1, 2, 3]
    遍歷 取自 numeri 設為 n {
        註記 n
    }
}
faber convert --to vi — Vietnamese
bắt_đầu {
    đặt danh_sách<số> numeri ← [1, 2, 3]
    lặp từ numeri đặt n {
        ghi_chú n
    }
}
faber convert --to ar — Arabic
بداية {
    ليكن قائمة<عدد> numeri ← [1, 2, 3]
    كرر من numeri ليكن n {
        اعرض n
    }
}
faber convert --to hi — Hindi
आरंभ {
    बैठा सूची<संख्या> numeri ← [1, 2, 3]
    दोहराओ सेवन numeri बैठा n {
        दिखाओ n
    }
}

In lockstep#

from also accepts a comma series: give it N collections and N name binders, and the loop walks them all in lockstep — one shared index, one value from each list per turn:

main {
    let list<string> nomina ← ["Alia", "Brunus"]
    let list<int> aetates ← [34, 27]
    for from nomina, aetates at [i] let name, aetas {
        print i, name, aetas
    }
}

at (English at) names the shared index. The sources are listas, the binders are plain names, and the first source owns the length: if a later list is shorter, the loop stops with a runtime error rather than silently truncating to the minimum.

Over keys#

freader locale
faber convert --to en — English reader surface
main {
    let map<string, string> persona ← { "nomen": "Marcus", "urbs": "Roma" }
    for ref persona let clavis {
        print clavis, persona[clavis]
    }
}
faber convert --to la — canonical Faber
incipit {
    sit tabula<textus, textus> persona ← { "nomen": "Marcus", "urbs": "Roma" }
    itera de persona sit clavis {
        nota clavis, persona[clavis]
    }
}
faber convert --to th-TH — Thai
เริ่ม {
    กำหนด ตาราง<ข้อความ, ข้อความ> persona ← { "nomen": "Marcus", "urbs": "Roma" }
    วน จาก persona กำหนด clavis {
        บันทึก clavis, persona[clavis]
    }
}
faber convert --to zh-Hans — Simplified Chinese
入口 {
    设 映射<文本, 文本> persona ← { "nomen": "Marcus", "urbs": "Roma" }
    遍历 借自 persona 设 clavis {
        显示 clavis, persona[clavis]
    }
}
faber convert --to zh-Hant — Traditional Chinese
入口 {
    設為 表格<文字, 文字> persona ← { "nomen": "Marcus", "urbs": "Roma" }
    遍歷 從 persona 設為 clavis {
        註記 clavis, persona[clavis]
    }
}
faber convert --to vi — Vietnamese
bắt_đầu {
    đặt bảng<văn_bản, văn_bản> persona ← { "nomen": "Marcus", "urbs": "Roma" }
    lặp ra persona đặt clavis {
        ghi_chú clavis, persona[clavis]
    }
}
faber convert --to ar — Arabic
بداية {
    ليكن جدول<نص, نص> persona ← { "nomen": "Marcus", "urbs": "Roma" }
    كرر عن persona ليكن clavis {
        اعرض clavis, persona[clavis]
    }
}
faber convert --to hi — Hindi
आरंभ {
    बैठा तालिका<पाठ, पाठ> persona ← { "nomen": "Marcus", "urbs": "Roma" }
    दोहराओ से persona बैठा clavis {
        दिखाओ clavis, persona[clavis]
    }
}

Over a range#

‥ builds a range. The lower bound is included, the upper bound is not.

freader locale
faber convert --to en — English reader surface
main {
    for range 0 ‥ 3 let i {
        print i
    }
}
faber convert --to la — canonical Faber
incipit {
    itera ab 0 ‥ 3 sit i {
        nota i
    }
}
faber convert --to th-TH — Thai
เริ่ม {
    วน ช่วง 0 ‥ 3 กำหนด i {
        บันทึก i
    }
}
faber convert --to zh-Hans — Simplified Chinese
入口 {
    遍历 范围 0 ‥ 3 设 i {
        显示 i
    }
}
faber convert --to zh-Hant — Traditional Chinese
入口 {
    遍歷 範圍 0 ‥ 3 設為 i {
        註記 i
    }
}
faber convert --to vi — Vietnamese
bắt_đầu {
    lặp khoảng 0 ‥ 3 đặt i {
        ghi_chú i
    }
}
faber convert --to ar — Arabic
بداية {
    كرر نطاق 0 ‥ 3 ليكن i {
        اعرض i
    }
}
faber convert --to hi — Hindi
आरंभ {
    दोहराओ सीमा 0 ‥ 3 बैठा i {
        दिखाओ i
    }
}

A range is also a value. Store it, print it, and walk it later; the English type word is range<int>.

freader locale
faber convert --to en — English reader surface
main {
    let range<int> r ← 0 ‥ 3
    print r
    for range r let i {
        print i
    }
}
faber convert --to la — canonical Faber
incipit {
    sit intervallum<numerus> r ← 0 ‥ 3
    nota r
    itera ab r sit i {
        nota i
    }
}
faber convert --to th-TH — Thai
เริ่ม {
    กำหนด อันตรภาค<จํานวน> r ← 0 ‥ 3
    บันทึก r
    วน ช่วง r กำหนด i {
        บันทึก i
    }
}
faber convert --to zh-Hans — Simplified Chinese
入口 {
    设 区间<整数> r ← 0 ‥ 3
    显示 r
    遍历 范围 r 设 i {
        显示 i
    }
}
faber convert --to zh-Hant — Traditional Chinese
入口 {
    設為 區間<整數> r ← 0 ‥ 3
    註記 r
    遍歷 範圍 r 設為 i {
        註記 i
    }
}
faber convert --to vi — Vietnamese
bắt_đầu {
    đặt miền<số> r ← 0 ‥ 3
    ghi_chú r
    lặp khoảng r đặt i {
        ghi_chú i
    }
}
faber convert --to ar — Arabic
بداية {
    ليكن فترة<عدد> r ← 0 ‥ 3
    اعرض r
    كرر نطاق r ليكن i {
        اعرض i
    }
}
faber convert --to hi — Hindi
आरंभ {
    बैठा अंतराल<संख्या> r ← 0 ‥ 3
    दिखाओ r
    दोहराओ सीमा r बैठा i {
        दिखाओ i
    }
}

A stored range can carry a step, and the step is part of its type: let range<int, 2> evens ← 0 … 10 step 2 walks 0, 2, … 10, and evens.length() is 6. See ranges.

While#

while loops while a condition holds.

freader locale
faber convert --to en — English reader surface
main {
    mut int i ← 0
    while i ≺ 3 {
        i ← i + 1
        print i
    }
}
faber convert --to la — canonical Faber
incipit {
    varia numerus i ← 0
    dum i ≺ 3 {
        i ← i + 1
        nota i
    }
}
faber convert --to th-TH — Thai
เริ่ม {
    แก้ไขได้ จํานวน i ← 0
    ขณะ i ≺ 3 {
        i ← i + 1
        บันทึก i
    }
}
faber convert --to zh-Hans — Simplified Chinese
入口 {
    可变 整数 i ← 0
    当 i ≺ 3 {
        i ← i + 1
        显示 i
    }
}
faber convert --to zh-Hant — Traditional Chinese
入口 {
    可變 整數 i ← 0
    當 i ≺ 3 {
        i ← i + 1
        註記 i
    }
}
faber convert --to vi — Vietnamese
bắt_đầu {
    khả_biến số i ← 0
    trong_khi i ≺ 3 {
        i ← i + 1
        ghi_chú i
    }
}
faber convert --to ar — Arabic
بداية {
    قابل_للتغيير عدد i ← 0
    طالما i ≺ 3 {

}
faber convert --to hi — Hindi
आरंभ {

}

Leaving early#

break breaks out; continue skips to the next iteration.

freader locale
faber convert --to en — English reader surface
main {
    let list<int> numeri ← [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    for from numeri let n {
        if n ≡ 2 {
            continue
        }
        if n ≻ 3 {
            break
        }
        print n
    }
}
faber convert --to la — canonical Faber
incipit {
    sit lista<numerus> numeri ← [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    itera ex numeri sit n {
        si n ≡ 2 {
            perge
        }
        si n ≻ 3 {
            rumpe
        }
        nota n
    }
}
faber convert --to th-TH — Thai
เริ่ม {
    กำหนด รายการ<จํานวน> numeri ← [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    วน ออก numeri กำหนด n {
        ถ้า n ≡ 2 {
            ไปต่อ
        }
        ถ้า n ≻ 3 {
            หยุด
        }
        บันทึก n
    }
}
faber convert --to zh-Hans — Simplified Chinese
入口 {
    设 列表<整数> numeri ← [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    遍历 取自 numeri 设 n {
        如果 n ≡ 2 {
            继续
        }
        如果 n ≻ 3 {
            中断
        }
        显示 n
    }
}
faber convert --to zh-Hant — Traditional Chinese
入口 {
    設為 列表<整數> numeri ← [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    遍歷 取自 numeri 設為 n {
        若 n ≡ 2 {
            繼續
        }
        若 n ≻ 3 {
            中斷
        }
        註記 n
    }
}
faber convert --to vi — Vietnamese
bắt_đầu {
    đặt danh_sách<số> numeri ← [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    lặp từ numeri đặt n {
        nếu n ≡ 2 {
            tiếp
        }
        nếu n ≻ 3 {
            dừng
        }
        ghi_chú n
    }
}
faber convert --to ar — Arabic
بداية {
    ليكن قائمة<عدد> numeri ← [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    كرر من numeri ليكن n {
        إذا n ≡ 2 {
            تابع
        }
        إذا n ≻ 3 {
            اكسر
        }
        اعرض n
    }
}
faber convert --to hi — Hindi
आरंभ {
    बैठा सूची<संख्या> numeri ← [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    दोहराओ सेवन numeri बैठा n {
        यदि n ≡ 2 {
            जारी
        }
        यदि n ≻ 3 {
            तोड़ो
        }
        दिखाओ n
    }
}

A loop can also carry its own error handler — see catch attaches to more than do.

Thread loops#

A loop marked thread (la thread) runs its iterations as independent lanes: for from src at [i, j] thread lane let v { … }. Because the lanes run independently, one lane cannot stop the others. continue skips the rest of this lane, but break is SEM010 break_in_thread_body and a plain return is SEM010 return_in_thread_body. To use a lane's own stores, write only that lane's coordinate; a loop whose independence the compiler cannot prove is SEM010 filum_independence_unproven.

return thread (la return thread) ends the current lane from any depth of the lane body's own blocks. It takes no value, because lanes deliver results through their stores. Anywhere else it is refused: outside a thread loop (SEM010 return_thread_outside_lane), with a value (SEM010 return_thread_with_value), or inside a nested closure or reduction body (SEM010 return_thread_in_nested_body).

kernel lane_exit(tensor<f32, [4]> values) → void {
    for from values at [i] thread lane let value {
        return thread
    }
}
fn run() → void {
    return thread
}

main {
    run()
}

Known issue in 1.18: return thread is checked but not yet compiled. The code generators and the lowering to the runner's form refuse it by name (return_thread_lowering_pending), so a program that uses it passes `faber check and stops at faber check --lower, faber build and faber run`. The formatter keeps it as written.
